retrieval_contract.source_query: Explicit IDs over the development + reserved union; no disease filter; retain PPI partners in this same full resolved union.
retrieval_contract.completeness: Every requested family must reconcile to complete, with one database version before/after; no replacement genes.
retrieval_contract.freshness: Refresh all HTTP requests in a unique cohort cache; no older snapshot mixing.

cohort.development_roles: Previous train+validation genes become training; previous test genes become development validation. All are already exposed genes. Reserved genes alone are final test.
cohort.sample_roles: Preserve all original recorded sample-group assignments; these are not new laboratory cohorts.

remaining_requirements: Review source provenance and provisional feature definitions, including missing/capped cases.
Freeze gene-level aggregation/deduplication, endpoint, ranking rule, simple baselines and tissue-sample partitions before examining dependency values.

source_review.review_kind: AI-authored implementation/source-contract review; not biological gold adjudication

decision.interpretation: The frozen pilot does not demonstrate an incremental gain; preserve the result without retuning on this holdout.

result.claim_scope: One predeclared primary comparison on previously reserved genes in a historical processed release, conditional on adaptive development; no claim of full-Pharos, clinical, GNN/link-prediction or pruning superiority.
limitations: No outcome-based cohort changes, post-test feature/threshold adjustment or extra model search. Changes require a new protocol and a fresh holdout.
Modern Pharos annotations postdate the 2024 outcomes; this is not temporal or prospective validation. Pathway/assay releases and full study independence are unresolved.
Chronos was jointly processed upstream; holding out models here does not undo shared preprocessing or establish independent laboratory replication.
Sample-group IDs do not prove independent donors. Bootstrap scope excludes training and cohort-selection uncertainty. General growth dependency in CRC models is not CRC-selective dependency.
All 256 old genes and previous validation judgments are development. Hypotheses were informed by exposed pilot results; this fresh-gene test is conditional on that development.
This is a fixed retrospective ranking experiment, not a GNN/link-prediction/pruning benchmark or prospective independent laboratory replication.
Do not delete or reject evidence records merely because their representation underperformed.
Secondary arm scores and permutation distributions are descriptive. Do not select a test winner or reinterpret its score as another primary result.

retrieval_retry_receipt.failure: Pharos HTTP 502 on multi-protein expression pages after the configured retries
